sa_candidates.reason: the 11 defs of sa_rest_fetch.py minus the 6 non-endpoint helpers leave 5 endpoints (symbol, news, report, analysis, article) and none returns a comparables list; and build_session() needs the parked session bundle from Secrets Manager 'seeking-alpha/session' (the CRO's session vault), so the call is not reachable under this session's egress -- recorded as an INPUT candidate that does not exist, never as the rule

peers.test: comparable = the deepest of four lexicographic rungs the candidate reaches: (1) same SECTOR (scanner UniverseDataRow.sector; a model-block subject's GICS_SECTOR_NAME is mapped into that vocabulary by GICS11_TO_SCANNER13_v1), then (2) a SIZE BAND of 0.2x-5.0x of the subject's market cap (UniverseDataRow.mktVal in USD millions; a model-block subject's CUR_MKT_CAP divided by 1e6), then (3) same COUNTRY (UniverseDataRow.country; CNTRY_OF_DOMICILE mapped by ISO3166A2_TO_SCANNER_COUNTRY_v1), then (4) same SUBSECTOR (UniverseDataRow.industryGroup); ties inside the deepest rung broken by the numeric similarity |log(candidate cap / subject cap)|. Similarity of business and scale, never valuation.
